Mira Chen: Quick heads-up — switching the all-hands order: product roadmap first, then org updates. Still starting at 11:00. Please hang tight for 5–10m while we confirm streaming/recording.

EngBot: :rotating_light: Recorder service reported 'SEGMENT_WRITE_FAILURE' at 2026-03-23T10:42:15Z. Auto-restart attempt 1/3.

Oliver Ruiz: I can ssh into the presentation VM and check the recorder. On it now.

Oliver Ruiz: FYI ran `systemctl restart recorder.service` — journal shows this error repeatedly: `recorder: Failed to allocate segment buffer (errno 12)`. Looks like disk pressure on /var/recordings.

Jas Patel: Copy — if recorder won't start up, I'll run a local OBS capture of the slides and stream via Zoom. I have a backup laptop ready.

EngBot: Restart attempt 2/3 succeeded but backup upload failed: S3 502. Mirror upload disabled, streaming may still work but recording might not persist.

Simon Lee: Suggestion — flip the agenda now while we sort recording. Move product roadmap first so the key talk is captured if stream flaps. Mira, want to do that?

Mira Chen: Yes do the flip. Also, if recording ends up corrupted, we'll do a short follow-up doc + re-recorded demos. Please add any live Qs to this thread so we can triage if audio/video drops.

Haley Rivera: I'll own live notes and timestamps. If recording is bad, we'll publish notes + time-indexed clips. Posting a quick checklist in case of failure:
```
- Start Zoom fallback (link below)
- Local OBS capture on backup laptop
- Save slides as PDF and upload to #docs immediately
- Haley to timestamp Q&A and ping follow-ups
```

Oliver Ruiz: Zoom fallback link (temp): https://zoom.us/j/123456789 (passcode: redwood). I hooked OBS to that link, doing a test now.

Jas Patel: Tested audio levels — mic on presenter laptop is low. Quick fix: System Preferences -> Sound -> Input -> increase gain, or use `pactl set-source-volume @DEFAULT_SOURCE@ +15%` on Linux.

Mira Chen: Thanks — everyone with action items: Oliver (recorder/disk), Jas (OBS + local capture), Haley (notes + timestamps), Simon (agenda order), I'll relay to leadership for any roadmap Qs.

EngBot: Recorder auto-restart exhausted attempts (3/3). Current status: ONLINE (streaming only), RECORDING=false.

Simon Lee: Switching agenda now. Slides will be queued for product. Heads-up presenters to start.

Haley Rivera: I'll start a thread in #all-hands-notes with live timestamps and drop the recording link (Zoom/OBS) after.

Mira Chen: If recording ends up missing, we'll compile an actions + summary doc within 24 hours and share with everyone. Please drop any questions about roadmap or migrations here and we'll triage in the Q&A segment. :wave:
